name: io.github.wangyingsm/dr-strange
title: Dr Strange
description: Code graph for coding agents: who calls this, what a change reaches, in one round trip.

packageArguments.description: Serve the graph in `./graph.drsg` over MCP, JSON-RPC and the dashboard. The database has to exist: `npx @yingge/drsg init` digests this repository, starts the server itself and writes `.mcp.json`, and is the shorter path for a developer at a terminal. This entry runs `serve` instead because `init` picks a free port and a random token, neither of which a static record can name.

packageArguments.name: --addr
packageArguments.description: Bind address, stated rather than defaulted so it agrees with the URL below whatever a local `drsg.toml` says.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: The token the server was started with. `/mcp` is gated at write level, and a tokenless server grants only its own same-origin browser UI, so an MCP client without this header is refused every call.

environmentVariables.name: DRSG_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Bearer token this server requires of every client, and the value the Authorization header above is built from. Any secret will do — it is checked against itself, not issued by anything.
